text: {"lessons":["Selling B, E, and D for gains felt good, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should weigh each stock’s outlook and portfolio role.","I held A and C through steep losses before selling, so I should set clear reasons to hold and revisit them sooner rather than let reluctance to admit a mistake decide for me.","After buying more B, I should assess the added position on its own merits and keep enough cash and diversification to manage risk without reacting to short-term price moves."]}
